title: FB-019 align config default root family
summary: Fix FR-006 by aligning PowerShell setup defaults with the generated schema, default profile, and config identity template root family.
reason: Worker finding W02-004 showed Get-MediaPipelineConfigDefaultValues still seeded C:\Videos roots while Python contracts, generated schema, config template, default profile, and identity guards use C:\MediaPipeline roots.
behavior_before: PowerShell default config values used C:\Videos\Incoming, C:\Videos\Processed, and C:\Videos\Scratch roots.
behavior_after: PowerShell default config values use C:\MediaPipeline\Incoming, C:\MediaPipeline\Processed, and C:\MediaPipeline\Scratch roots, matching Python contract defaults and identity template guards.
manual_validation: PowerShell config registry check failed red on old C:\Videos defaults, then passed after the fix; Invoke-ContractSchemaChecks.ps1 passed; PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_service_config_validation tests.python.desktop.test_service_config_path_warnings -q passed, 22 tests; tests.python.desktop.test_config_identity -q passed, 2 tests; tests.python.desktop.test_config_recovery -q passed, 15 tests. generate_config_schema --check and tests.python.core.contract.test_config_contract -q still fail on unrelated Quality* schema drift in the dirty tree.

validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered files: docs/implementation/dynamic-hdr-preservation/PLAN.md, docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Restore the C:\Videos PowerShell default root family and remove the default parity assertions, then rerun config schema/default checks.
notes: Packet created before code edits. No runtime media, LocalBase, queue, or source/output roots are touched by this change. ops/pipeline/engine/config/default_values.ps1 already contained unrelated watch/quality default edits in the dirty worktree; this packet covers only the C:\Videos to C:\MediaPipeline root-family change and the added parity assertions.
